env_template.name: LITELLM_BASE_URL
env_template.description: LiteLLM-compatible base URL (e.g. https://your-litellm-proxy/v1) used for the chat-formatting step - the anti-hallucination check needs a real model call, this demo has no offline fallback for it

env_template.name: LITELLM_API_KEY
env_template.description: API key for LITELLM_BASE_URL - never share this value outside your own local .env

env_template.name: LITELLM_DEFAULT_MODEL
env_template.description: Model name to request from LITELLM_BASE_URL, defaults to local-devstral-small2 if unset
